# the registry as a host entry (http), the server line naming Docker Hub as a fallback that is never reached: hosts are tried before the server
sudo mkdir -p "/etc/containerd/certs.d/v048011.dom600.test:5000"
sudo tee "/etc/containerd/certs.d/v048011.dom600.test:5000/hosts.toml" >/dev/null <<'TOML'
server = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
[host."http://v048011.dom600.test:5000"]
  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve"]
TOML
sudo ctr -a /run/bench65681045/containerd.sock images pull --hosts-dir /etc/containerd/certs.d v048011.dom600.test:5000/myjenkins:latest
sudo ctr -a /run/bench65681045/containerd.sock run --rm v048011.dom600.test:5000/myjenkins:latest bench65681045-check /app hello </dev/null

# the "New" layout of the accepted answer as written there: skip_verify = true on an http:// host entry. In this containerd it makes
# the entry be tried over TLS (and Docker Hub, the server, is refused): skip_verify is about TLS certificates and an HTTP registry has none
sudo mkdir -p "/etc/containerd/certs.d/v048011.dom600.test:5000"
sudo tee "/etc/containerd/certs.d/v048011.dom600.test:5000/hosts.toml" >/dev/null <<'TOML'
server = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
[host."http://v048011.dom600.test:5000"]
  capabilities = ["pull", "resolve", "push"]
  skip_verify = true
TOML
sudo ctr -a /run/bench65681045/containerd.sock images pull --hosts-dir /etc/containerd/certs.d v048011.dom600.test:5000/myjenkins:latest
sudo ctr -a /run/bench65681045/containerd.sock run --rm v048011.dom600.test:5000/myjenkins:latest bench65681045-check /app hello </dev/null
